turns.label: svg-created
turns.instruction: Create an original editable 2D SVG of a white pelican riding a bicycle with a blue frame and orange beak, over my footage for all five seconds. Use meaningful names for the bird, beak, bicycle frame and wheels. Make one graphic item, keep the footage and its audio unchanged, and use the SVG preparation tool.

turns.label: svg-recolored
turns.instruction: Make only the bicycle frame red. Keep the pelican, wheels, placement, duration and other content unchanged.

turns.label: three-created
turns.instruction: Create an original editable 3D scene of a white pelican riding a bicycle with an orange frame and dark wheels, over my footage for all five seconds. Give it a slowly orbiting camera. Use meaningful object/material names. Make one transparent 3D item and keep the footage and audio unchanged.

turns.label: three-recolored
turns.instruction: Make only the bicycle frame blue. Keep the pelican, wheels, placement, duration and other content unchanged.

turns.label: three-camera
turns.instruction: Move the camera slightly higher. Preserve every object, material, animation and clip duration.
